events.title: Schooners Beachside Live – Weekend Concert Series
events.summary: Free outdoor live music every Sat & Sun at Schooners' beachfront patio. House bands + local/touring acts all summer into fall.

events.title: Schooners Open Mic Night
events.summary: Weekly open mic every Wednesday night at Schooners. Free for all skill levels; local musicians and drop-ins welcome.

events.title: ECOSLO Cayucos Beach Cleanup
events.summary: Volunteer beach cleanup at Cayucos Beach removing litter from high-use visitor areas. One of four peak-season cleanup dates in 2026.

events.title: ECOSLO Cayucos Beach Cleanup
events.summary: Autumn volunteer beach cleanup at Cayucos Beach. Part of the California Coastal Cleanup Day season; all welcome to help.

events.title: Cayucos Fall Antique Street Faire (40th Edition)
events.venue: N. Ocean Ave (Cayucos Dr to E St), Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: 40th annual fall edition of the beloved outdoor antique fair. ~100 dealers selling antiques, vintage & collectibles along Ocean Ave. Free admission, rain or shine.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.venue: N. Ocean Ave & Cayucos Dr, Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: 35th annual classic car show filling downtown Cayucos. Includes live band, Lions BBQ lunch & beer garden. Friday eve check-in party at Nelson's Garage.

events.title: Christmas in Cayucos – Tree Lighting & Wonderland Walk
events.venue: Corner of D St & Ocean Ave, Downtown Cayucos
events.summary: Annual holiday tree lighting with Santa arriving by fire engine, horse-drawn carriage rides, shops open late & Lioness Club refreshments. Date is estimated (2025 was Dec 12–13).
